jobs.description:
Do you look for a new challenge within the dynamic and fast paced Wealth Management environment? Do you want to be part of a high performing team? Do you have a "can do" mentality and want to be part of our growth story and create impact? Do you want to proactively go the extra mile with us to help our sophisticated clients? Are you curious, proactive and always striving to bring positive impact to clients?

We’re looking for a client account manager to:

• manage daily business in PC / HNW client servicing and provide high quality service
• be the point of entry for processing client orders, e.g. stock orders, foreign exchange, loans and deposits
• be the direct contact for daily banking activities and administrative work for our clients
• manage daily client transactions and carry out inquiries and troubleshooting
• perform account maintenance tasks and client-related processes; e.g. account opening and closing, suitability reviews, initial and recurring KYC and due diligence
• research, follow-up and resolve client inquiries and problems through effective interaction with clients, and internal partners in a timely and professional manner
• identify cross-selling opportunities and discuss them with the client advisor
• support client advisors in delivering exceptional client service and experience, taking care of administrative, risk and legal & compliance related tasks and duties
• support client advisors when they are on business trips and assist in preparing client meetings
• join client advisors occasionally in client meetings

jobs.title: Portfolio Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
The Global Wealth Management Banking Americas group offers products and services to UBS Financial advisors and clients to help them meet their financial needs and goals. The products and offerings include loans to High New Worth (HNW) and Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) clients of the firm. The Credit Risk Manager role is part of the team’s 1st line of defense support.

• Lead Mumbai Lending team to support onshore team in managing a portfolio of loans to HNW and UHNW clients consisting of various collateral types including but not limited to Marketable Securities, Private Equity, Hedge Funds, LP interests, and Unsecured
• Assist in preparing high quality credit presentations within defined periodic review due dates that accurately summarize the loan purpose, terms and conditions, sources of repayment, risks, credit strengths and weaknesses
• apply financial principles, theories, concepts, and techniques to analyze information and loan collateral in accordance with policies, procedures, and industry practice
• keep current on major developments and changes in market and client financial condition to identify and escalate potential negative trends that could lead to the deterioration of credit quality and internal ratings
• maintain and update borrower’s loan data in internal systems and trackers
• participate in the development and ongoing updates to process and procedure documents

We’re looking for a Market Team Head for our Global Wealth Management business. We are looking for someone to:

• head a desk comprising our private bankers known as Client Advisors (CAs)
• to help the CAs build, establish and grow long-term client relationships
• develop team members across all aspects including helping the team provide trusted advice to clients drawing on expertise from across our global organization
• manage the team's needs, risk management issues and ensure the delivery of the entire suite of our bank's products and solutions
• help the team identify potential HNW/UHNW clients and coordinate cross-bank coverage for the clients
• ensure compliance guidelines are strictly adhered to when interacting with clients and prospects. Comply with all regulations, policies and standards, contributing to an effective risk culture
• break down barriers and overcome operational bottlenecks to ensure a flawless client experience

jobs.title: Team Lead Lombard Lending & Deposits
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned lending professional with deep Lombard expertise and a strong sense of ownership? Do you enjoy leading people while remaining hands on in complex transactions and strategic initiatives?
We are looking for a Director – Team Lead Lombard Lending & Deposits to lead the delivery of secured lending and deposits solutions in Taiwan. This is a senior role combining client-facing origination, product ownership and line management responsibility, with accountability for business growth, risk stewardship and people development.
In this role, you will be accountable for:
Lombard Lending Origination & Structuring
• act as the senior subject matter expert for Lombard lending in Taiwan, supporting Client Advisors and clients across the end to end financing lifecycle
• originate, structure and execute complex and bespoke Lombard lending transactions
o act as transaction lead for higher-risk or strategically important cases
o provide subject matter expertise and guidance for smaller/ less complex transactions
• develop and promote leverage solutions to client advisors to generate client interest and leverage demand
• drive sales momentum and conversion by identifying lending opportunities within existing and new client relationships
• provide expert guidance on pricing, leverage, structuring and risk trade offs, ensuring appropriate and sustainable use of credit
• participate in selected direct client interactions alongside Client Advisors to support origination, execution and client education
Deposits Business Ownership & Pricing
• serve as the local functional owner for the deposits business in Taiwan, with responsibility for product oversight, pricing discipline and commercial outcomes
• perform deposit pricing and balance sheet analysis, supporting business decisions and sales initiatives
• design and drive deposit sales campaigns in close partnership with control functions and frontline leadership
• liaise with Group Treasury and Investment Banking on funding considerations, pricing frameworks and group balance sheet preferences
• ensure clear and consistent communication of deposit strategy, pricing guidance and constraints to the business
People & Line Management
• line manage, coach and develop two team members, setting clear objectives and supporting their professional growth
• allocate deal responsibilities and product tasks appropriately, ensuring high-quality execution and knowledge transfer
• foster a strong team culture grounded in collaboration, accountability, risk awareness and client focus
• provide structured feedback, performance input and career guidance in line with UBS people principles
Product, Risk & Control Responsibilities
• maintain ownership of the local Lombard and deposits product shelf, including product maintenance, governance and pricing frameworks
• ensure compliance with local regulation and UBS internal policies, fulfilling first-line risk management responsibilities
• oversee portfolio monitoring, reporting and issue remediation in partnership with Risk, Legal and Compliance
• stay abreast of market developments, competitor activity and regulatory change, proactively adapting local offerings
Strategy, Change & Stakeholder Management
• develop and execute local lending and deposits growth strategies aligned with regional and global objectives
• contribute to new product development and enhancement initiatives with Global Lending distribution teams
• act as the local interface with IT and change teams on system enhancements, process improvements and digitisation initiatives
• collaborate extensively across Wealth Management, Credit Risk, Investments and Banking to deliver integrated client solutions

• contribute to product development, new use cases and initiatives across automation and AI enabled solutions, while supporting cross selling of the broader Data Intelligence product suite

jobs.title: Product Owner – Digital Capabilities
jobs.description:
Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and are you eager to understand and fulfill our clients’ needs? Do you want to play a key role in transforming our firm into an agile organization? Are you enthusiastic about the future of working in an AI driven world?

At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other – our colleagues, clients and partners – and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative.

We’re looking for a Product Owner to:

• Co-develop and maintain a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for building out agentic capabilities in our core platforms.
• Define and maintain Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) aligned to product and business strategy
• Collaborate with end users in IB Operations to communicate art of the possible and identify business processes that can benefit from AI tooling
• Assess potential use cases objectively and understand business value vs cost of solution, looking to reuse or extend existing capabilities where feasible
• Influence the design of new solutions to deliver benefit for multiple stakeholders where possible
• Maintain pod and iteration backlogs in Gitlab to a high standard
• Obtain necessary governance approvals for new use cases / solutions
• Keep current with industry trends and emerging technologies in AI / ML space, and apply external perspectives and insights to improve our offering
• Mitigate impediments to the team’s goals, align across pods and with other crews where needed and act as your pod’s ambassadors towards internal stakeholders and clients

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about applying quantitative methods to real-world investment challenges? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where your portfolio construction skills and analytical thinking can drive innovation in portfolio risk management?

We’re looking for someone who can:

• Perform and document comprehensive reviews of discretionary investment strategies managed by U.S. Financial Advisors (FAs), with a detailed focus on investment process, dispersion analysis, performance, trading implementation, and related operational controls.
• Engage Financial Advisor (FA) teams to explain Investment Manager Analysis (IMA) observations and provide targeted coaching designed to strengthen their investment decision-making and drive improved long-term portfolio outcomes.
• Contribute to recurring governance meetings/committees for discretionary strategies; set agendas, curate materials, coordinate key stakeholders, and ensure decisions, actions, owners, and timelines are clearly captured; drive escalations and follow ups to closure.
• Serve as a subject matter expert for our discretionary programs; field questions from FA teams and cross functional partners, providing timely, well supported guidance on program design, oversight standards, and best practices.
• Participate in evolving the strategic vision for discretionary programs to ensure robust oversight and governance frameworks while preserving each FA’s ability to effectively navigate and manage discretionary portfolios.
• Curate and continuously improve review artifacts (e.g., strategy review packs, dispersion/performance readouts, trading checklists) to support both initial due diligence and ongoing monitoring.
• Partner across stakeholders to translate insights into pragmatic enhancements to process, controls, and client outcomes, reinforcing accountability and transparency throughout the program lifecycle.

jobs.description:
Build highly scalable, client facing platforms using Java, Spring Boot and Azure Cloud.

• Do you want to design and build enterprise scale, client facing applications using Java, Spring Boot, and cloud native technologies on Azure?
• Are you excited by distributed systems, high availability, and platforms used daily by clients across the globe?
• If you’re looking to start your career in a high energy, international agile environment that strongly encourages learning and professional growth, take your next career step with UBS.

As part of your team, you will

• •Design, build, and maintain highly scalable, first tier client facing applications within Wealth Management.
• •Develop cloud native services using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and modern engineering practices.
• •Work on distributed systems running on Azure Cloud and managed AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service).
• •Use Redis and other data technologies to build low latency, resilient platforms.
• •Collaborate closely with product owners, UX, and business stakeholders to understand and refine requirements.
• •Apply Agile and DevOps principles, contributing across the full SDLC (design, development, testing, release, and support).
• •Write clean, testable code and contribute to TDD, code reviews, and architectural discussions.
• •Ensure solutions meet high standards for performance, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
• •Investigate incidents, perform root cause analysis, and help continuously improve platform stability.
• •Document solutions clearly and share knowledge within the team and wider engineering community.

Tech Graduate Program
• You will participate in our immersive global Tech Graduate Program, designed to accelerate your development as a software engineer. The program offers:
• •Hands on experience from day one on real, business critical platforms.
• •Exposure to cutting edge technologies including cloud, containers, and distributed systems.
• •Professional development through structured learning, certifications, and engineering communities.
• •Guidance from experienced engineers and architects who will mentor and support your growth.
• •A collaborative, international environment where you learn from peers across regions.
• •Career advancement through an 18 month comprehensive program starting in August 2026, setting you up for long term success at UBS.

• support by escalating any potential testing issues or exceptions to the appropriate teams

jobs.title: Process and Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you have a high client service orientation and a high risk awareness? Do you like working with colleagues across the organization and are you good with stakeholder management? We're looking for someone like that to:
– Act as an Onboarding & KYC Advisor to client advisor on onboarding and Periodic KYC Review (PKR) cases across the WM. Understand and articulate KYC requirements and work with client advisor through the onboarding and PKR processes.
– Be proactive and respond timely to market and business partner’s queries. Facilitate exceptional handling on risk-based approach, and coordinate with Business and Financial Crime / Compliance for signoff.
Review background check screening on the client, provide support on client profile with client advisor, and gather corroboration evidence material where available. Support client advisor to ensure regulatory compliance of submitted materials from client and client advisor themself.
– Handle Periodic KYC Review (PKR) case review from start to end, including client profile updates after consulting with client advisor. Further, perform KYC profile checking activities linked to client onboarding requests and ensure client KYC information consistency with PKR Quality Checks.
– Support client advisor on non-KYC aspects of PKR (i.e. file conversion for archival, raise additional name search request to middle office, escalate for Due Diligence Officer (DDO) review, PKR case manager management.
• – Think flexibly to propose new ideas and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and services.
• – Be-able to act as mentor for junior teammates and cascade management message in an effective and accurate manner
• – Be a trusted partner of market as well as other business partners.

jobs.title: Premises Operations & Key Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you solid as a rock when delivering large projects with set deadlines and budget? Are you passionate about corporate real estate portfolio strategy? Do you know how to manage and motivate teams? Are you interested in sustainability topics, from environmental management to LEED certifications? Do you like to analyze complex data?

This role includes assisting the team with strategic planning and management of the real estate portfolio for all UBS AUS/NZ offices, includes all AUS/NZ premises projects and related activities for UBS. For the first 18 months this role will assume the responsibility of Project Sponsor for the new UBS Sydney office project. This will require leadership of the project team taking responsibility to deliver the new Sydney office to the agreed time frame and budget allocated.

Major responsibilities would include:

Real Estate:
- Involvement with Real estate short and long term strategy, negotiation with Landlord directly or through real estate consultants for any lease related transaction
- Real estate planning, space planning / optimisation solutions for changing with business requirements
- Prepare recommendation papers and seek property and cost approvals for minor works projects from UBS management within designated areas of responsibility and in line with limits of delegation
- Managing and vetting the AUS/NZ Rental Invoices on a monthly basis to ensure the data is accurate to recommend for approval
- The ongoing development and issuing of monthly occupancy space utilisation reports
- Ensure AUS/NZ comply with Regional requirements relating to the supervision of 3rd Party Real Estate providers

Projects and Churn Management:
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ locations for projects including office fit-outs (new and old), churns, office refurbishment and office stacking
- Work closely with Real Estate team locally and regionally (business management included) to provide Real Estate support that is consistent and coherent with the global framework in each of the UBS offices
- Generate RFP's for tenders with fair value recommendations working with the Procurement team
- Programme management of projects allowing successful planning in line with operating procedures for each phase of work, from start through to handover
- Monitor & proactively recommend workplace asset replacement / refurbishment in line with lifecycle / workplace conditions
- Prepare recommendation papers for business cases defining costs and benefit analysis
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ locations for reporting on space allocation and premise vacancy to be charged back and issued to business departments
- Consistent application of Real Estate related tools

Site Operations:
- Interact effectively with UBS internal business partners and establish a balanced engagement model with each of them and work with them in a professional and proactive challenging approach to ensure a balance between businesses requests and Real Estate strategy and policies.
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ facilities operations on cost management, budget and forecasting
- Overall management of external Integrated Facilities Management service provider which includes SLA's to ensure KPI's are being achieved, monthly reporting, QBR reviews and performance management
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ locations in corporate real estate and operations for incident management and escalation, business continuity / contingency planning
- Establish and maintain strong and effective working relationships with all business department managers
- Develop and maintain effective lines of communication to create best in class service delivery to all business partners and project stakeholders
- Manage and monitor regular workplace and condition inspections, ensuring the work items are appropriately instructed Include regular interaction with key business unit contacts to ensure satisfaction
- Provide managerial guidance to the local delivery teams and resolve first level enquiries
- WH&S ongoing development and management

jobs.description:
As a key member of the Cards Processing Team, you will serve as a hands-on individual contributor supporting critical card processing activities and ensuring accurate, timely, and well-controlled execution of daily operations between UBS, internal business partners, and card vendors. jobs.title: SAP Group Reporting Lead
jobs.description:
The Group Reporting Delivery Lead supports the delivery of the SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting capability within the ampliFi program, with accountability for ensuring accurate, controlled, and timely group consolidation and reporting outcomes in line with UBS accounting principles and governance. The role is responsible for driving disciplined execution across functional design, business validation, testing readiness, and production transition for Group Reporting scope, ensuring that consolidation processes, results, and disclosures meet Group Finance expectations.
The role partners closely with Group Finance, Consolidation teams, Data, Integration, and Technology stakeholders and acts as a functional representative for Group Reporting within the delivery. It ensures that business requirements for consolidation and reporting are translated into robust, well‑controlled solutions aligned with the target finance architecture and close processes.

• support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned Group Reporting workstreams or modules within the ampliFi finance and reporting stack, with clear ownership of consolidation and reporting outcomes.
• contribute to and review functional designs and configurations to ensure alignment with agreed consolidation architecture, accounting policies, reporting requirements, and close timelines.
• ensure that Group Reporting solutions support accurate consolidation, including intercompany eliminations, currency translation, ownership structures, and group hierarchies.
• develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts across Group Reporting integration points, including inflows from FPSL and General Ledger and downstream reporting consumption.
• proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with a focus on reporting accuracy, data integrity, close stability, and regulatory expectations, escalating where required.
• coordinate day‑to‑day delivery across Group Finance, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams to ensure coherent end‑to‑end execution aligned to consolidation and reporting cycles.
• ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, accounting principles, design decisions, and change control processes across Group Reporting scope.
• support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of consolidation scenarios, review of intercompany eliminations and adjustments, assessment of defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off.
• assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on stability of close and consolidation cycles, accuracy of reported results, and smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations post go‑live.

• Und schliesslich begeisterst Du die Kundinnen und Kunden für die digitale Welt und hilfst ihnen im Umgang mit E-Banking, Mobile Banking oder TWINT.

jobs.title: Business Risk Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about mitigating business risks and driving organizational success? As a key member of our Business Risk Organization team, you will play a crucial role in safeguarding our company's assets and ensuring sustainable growth.

In Business Risk Organization, we pride ourselves on our innovative approach and commitment to excellence. Join us in our mission to create a safer and more resilient business environment. We offer a dynamic work environment with ample opportunities for growth and development. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

We’re looking for Business Risk Specialist to:

• identify, assess and remediate operational risks (financial, reputational, regulatory, legal risks…) throughout the value chain
• act as a subject matter expert with focus on policies, processes and controls, issue tracking, risk monitoring and assessment as well as the definition of entailed required adaptions of the policies and control framework
• monitor changes and ongoing regulatory developments affecting the business
• initiate, support and track end to end implementation required due to changes in the policy or regulatory framework (e.g. documents, processes, controls, training curriculum…)

jobs.title: Spécialiste Crédits 80-100%
jobs.description:
Êtes-vous passionné par les prêts bancaires ? Vous êtes autonome, fiable et possédez une grande conscience professionnelle ? Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où les objectifs vous motivent ? Si vous avez répondu oui à ces questions, alors rejoignez notre équipe Credit Services et faites partie d'une entreprise où votre talent sera reconnu et valorisé.

En tant que spécialiste crédits, vous serez chargé de :

• traiter les demandes de prêt approuvées à l'échelle nationale, en jouant un rôle clé dans la réalisation des projets de nos clients
• préparer les contrats de crédit avec les documents de sûreté appropriés, assurant ainsi la documentation nécessaire à nos prêts
• saisir et gérer les crédits et garanties (p.ex. les cédules hypothécaires, polices et cautions)
• emettre les promesses de paiement et leur exécution
• assurer la correspondance et le dialogue avec les registres fonciers, notaires, banques et compagnies d’assurance, établissant des relations de confiance avec nos partenaires
• maintenir des contacts professionnels avec les conseillers à la clientèle, les Credit Officers et les services juridiques
